items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 17 at 7:37AM CDT until October 17 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40 mph.

* WHERE...Portions of south central and southwest Alabama, northwest
Florida, and southeast Mississippi.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will be capable of downing additional
compromised trees which would result in renewed power outages in
vulnerable areas impacted by the extreme winds during Hurricane
Isaias. In addition, large debris piles from storm cleanup may be
blown about resulting in additional hazards to anyone nearby
outdoors along with potentially blocking previously cleared
roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Many trees are leaning over power lines,
homes, and roads in the impacted area. Frequent wind gusts between
35 and 40 mph will create dangerous conditions outdoors in the
vulnerable areas. Elsewhere, winds may result in large tree
branches downed and localized power outages.
items.instruction:
Use extreme caution if you must travel or be outdoors. Remain alert
for potential falling trees and power lines, blown debris, and
additional damage to structures that remain compromised from the
hurricane.

items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 17 at 12:30AM CDT until October 20 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...In Alabama, Mobile Coastal and Baldwin Coastal
Counties. In Florida, Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and
Okaloosa Coastal Counties.

* WHEN...From this evening through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 17 at 7:30AM CDT until October 19 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with
gusts up to 35 kt and seas 3 to 6 ft. For the Small Craft
Advisory, northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt
and seas 4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS out
20 NM and Coastal waters from Okaloosa Walton County Line FL
to Pensacola FL out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 1 AM CDT Sunday. For the
Small Craft Advisory, from 1 AM Sunday to 7 PM CDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
